photos.name: both-loaves-finished
photos.summary: Both finished loaves side by side. Second loaf (no linen banneton) on wire rack in foreground with heavy blistering, deep golden-brown crust, and strong cross score. First loaf (linen banneton, ice cube) in background on a white cloth, noticeably paler and flatter.

photos.name: first-loaf-cooling-cross-score
photos.summary: First loaf cooling on a wire rack, top-down view. Cross score with moderate spring, golden but paler crust than recent bakes. This loaf proofed with linen liner and had an ice cube thrown into the Challenger.

photos.name: mixing-dough-closeup-video-frame
photos.summary: Dough ball on a silicone baking mat during fermentolyse rest, about 20 minutes after mixing flour, water, and starter. Smooth and cohesive surface with good tension.

photos.name: mixing-dough-video-frame
photos.summary: Dough on a silicone baking mat during fermentolyse rest. Rougher surface with visible fold lines, bench scraper nearby. Pre-salt stage.
